metadata.question: Did nighttime brightness over Houston decrease on May 18, 2024, compared to April 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Use VIIRS Black Marble daily nighttime lights (VNP46A2) for: • April 1–30, 2024 (monthly baseline mean) • May 18, 2024 (single day) - Geometry: Buffer 20 km around downtown Houston (-95.3698, 29.7604). 2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?). - Mask non-physical values: retain 0 < NTL < 10000 to avoid fill/invalid. - Report valid pixel counts and valid%. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - If collections empty: C1. - If valid pixel counts after masking are zero: C2. - If mean is null/NaN or outside reasonable range: C3. - Otherwise compare means: May18 < AprilMean → A (Yes), else B (No). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function getInfoAsync(obj) { return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { obj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e)); }); } function maskNTL(img, band) { // Keep only strictly positive and below a high ceiling to avoid fills/outliers. const ntl = img.select(band); const valid = ntl.gt(0).and(ntl.lt(10000)); return img.updateMask(valid); } async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.3698, 29.7604]).buffer(20000); // ~20 km around downtown Houston const aprilStart = '2024-04-01'; const mayStart = '2024-05-18'; const aprilEnd = '2024-05-01'; const mayEnd = '2024-05-19'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Fallback dataset selection const bandDaily = 'DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL'; let dailyDs = 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2'; // primary guess // Probe dataset; if fails, try alternate ID. try { // Probe a tiny call to ensure dataset ID exists. await getInfoAsync(ee.ImageCollection(dailyDs).limit(1).size()); } catch (e1) { dailyDs = 'NASA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2'; try { await getInfoAsync(ee.ImageCollection(dailyDs).limit(1).size()); } catch (e2) { console.log('Dataset error: VNP46A2 not found'); console.log('D'); return; } } // Build daily collections let aprilCol = ee.ImageCollection(dailyDs) .filterDate(aprilStart, aprilEnd) .filterBounds(roi) .map(function(img){ return maskNTL(img, bandDaily).select(bandDaily); }); let may18Col = ee.ImageCollection(dailyDs) .filterDate(mayStart, mayEnd) .filterBounds(roi) .map(function(img){ return maskNTL(img, bandDaily).select(bandDaily); }); const aprilSize = await getInfoAsync(aprilCol.size()); const may18Size = await getInfoAsync(may18Col.size()); // If April daily is empty, try monthly stable lights as fallback for April only let usedAprilMonthlyFallback = false; let aprilImg; let aprilBand = bandDaily; if (aprilSize === 0) { // Fallback to NOAA monthly VCMSLCFG (avg_rad) for April 2024 const monthlyDs = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG'; let aprilMonthly; try { aprilMonthly = ee.ImageCollection(monthlyDs) .filterDate(aprilStart, aprilEnd) .filterBounds(roi) .select('avg_rad'); const mSize = await getInfoAsync(aprilMonthly.size()); if (mSize === 0) { console.log('April Images: 0'); console.log('May18 Images: ' + may18Size); console.log('C1'); return; } aprilImg = aprilMonthly.mosaic().updateMask(aprilMonthly.first().select('avg_rad').gt(0)); aprilBand = 'avg_rad'; usedAprilMonthlyFallback = true; } catch (eMonthly) { console.log('April Images: 0'); console.log('May18 Images: ' + may18Size); console.log('D'); return; } } else { aprilImg = aprilCol.mean(); } if (may18Size === 0) { console.log('April Images: ' + (usedAprilMonthlyFallback ? 'MonthlyFallback' : aprilSize)); console.log('May18 Images: 0'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Build May 18 composite image const may18Img = may18Col.median(); // 3. Processing: Compute counts and means const scale = 1000; const maxPixels = 1e9; // April stats const aprilMeanDict = aprilImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const aprilCountDict = aprilImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const totalCountAprilDict = ee.Image.constant(1).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); // May 18 stats const mayMeanDict = may18Img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const mayCountDict = may18Img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const totalCountMayDict = ee.Image.constant(1).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const aprilMean = await getInfoAsync(aprilMeanDict.get(aprilBand)); const aprilValid = await getInfoAsync(aprilCountDict.get(aprilBand)); const aprilTotal = await getInfoAsync(totalCountAprilDict.get('constant')); const mayMean = await getInfoAsync(mayMeanDict.get(bandDaily)); const mayValid = await getInfoAsync(mayCountDict.get(bandDaily)); const mayTotal = await getInfoAsync(totalCountMayDict.get('constant')); // 4. Validation & Edge Cases if (!aprilValid || aprilValid === 0 || !mayValid || mayValid === 0) { console.log(`April Images: ${usedAprilMonthlyFallback ? 'MonthlyFallback' : aprilSize}`); console.log(`May18 Images: ${may18Size}`); console.log('Valid px (Apr/May18): ' + (aprilValid || 0) + '/' + (mayValid || 0)); console.log('C2'); return; } const isInvalid = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v) || v < 0 || v > 10000); if (isInvalid(aprilMean) || isInvalid(mayMean)) { console.log(`April Images: ${usedAprilMonthlyFallback ? 'MonthlyFallback' : aprilSize}`); console.log(`May18 Images: ${may18Size}`); console.log('C3'); return; } // 5. Results & Decision const aprilValidPct = aprilTotal ? (100 * aprilValid / aprilTotal) : 0; const mayValidPct = mayTotal ? (100 * mayValid / mayTotal) : 0; const delta = mayMean - aprilMean; const pctChange = (aprilMean !== 0) ? (100 * delta / aprilMean) : null; console.log(`April Images: ${usedAprilMonthlyFallback ? 'MonthlyFallback' : aprilSize} (mean=${aprilMean.toFixed(3)}, valid%=${aprilValidPct.toFixed(1)})`); console.log(`2024-05-18 Images: ${may18Size} (mean=${mayMean.toFixed(3)}, valid%=${mayValidPct.toFixed(1)})`); console.log(`Delta (May18 - AprMean): ${delta.toFixed(3)} (${pctChange !== null ? pctChange.toFixed(1) + '%' : 'NA'})`); // Final Answer if (mayMean < aprilMean) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
